solutionSql:
WITH booked AS (
  SELECT customer_id,
         to_char(booked_at AT TIME ZONE 'UTC', 'YYYY-MM') AS booked_month,
         booked_at
  FROM shipments
),
firsts AS (
  SELECT customer_id,
         to_char(min(booked_at) AT TIME ZONE 'UTC', 'YYYY-MM') AS first_month
  FROM shipments
  GROUP BY customer_id
)
SELECT f.customer_id,
       f.first_month,
       count(*)::integer AS shipments_in_month
FROM firsts AS f
JOIN booked AS b
  ON b.customer_id = f.customer_id
 AND b.booked_month = f.first_month
GROUP BY f.customer_id, f.first_month
ORDER BY f.customer_id;

ambiguities.phrase: the number of shipments they booked in that month
ambiguities.readingChosen: All of the customer's shipments whose booked_at falls in the same UTC calendar month as the first booking (whole month).
ambiguities.alternativeReading: Only shipments booked at the exact first booked_at instant, or a rolling 30 days from the first booking.

ambiguities.readingChosen: Month taken from booked_at AT TIME ZONE 'UTC', independent of the session TimeZone setting.
ambiguities.alternativeReading: Month in the session time zone (same result only while the session is UTC).

notes: First month from min(booked_at) converted to UTC; count joins back on customer and UTC month. Verified identical output with session TimeZone set to America/Los_Angeles. Inner grouping on shipments leaves out customers with no shipment (sample has 8 customers, 6 with shipments). Count cast to integer.
